name: Site Meta
description: Sets per-path page title, meta description and meta keywords via Site meta content entities, with core-token values and a path-prefix wildcard match.
project_description: The Site Meta module provides a flexible and easy method to set meta tags, such as page title, description and keywords for nodes, views and other different pages. Each rule is a 'Site meta' content entity keyed to an internal system path (for example /node/28, /taxonomy/term/1, or a path-prefix wildcard like /taxonomy/term/%). Values may contain node/term tokens, which are replaced against the current node or term when the page is rendered. The module also adds a 'Custom meta' section to the node edit form so a node's meta can be set inline. Manage rules at Administration > Content > Site meta.
